tldr: Burlington's Committee of the Whole approved several policy frameworks including Strong Mayor Powers guidelines and advisory committee governance, awarded a $12M tender for Walkers Line road renewal, and passed a controversial zoning amendment for Waterdown Road after extensive public consultation. The meeting spanned two days with significant time devoted to public input on the zoning matter.

items.title: Agenda approval with delegation time extension
items.notes: Council suspended rules to allow extended speaking time for community survey presentation and approved the agenda.

items.title: 2025 Treasurer's Statement for reserve funds
items.notes: Information report on Development Charges, Parkland Dedication and Community Benefit Charge reserve funds was received.

items.title: Walkers Line Renewal tender award
items.notes: Awarded $12.07M contract to PAVE-AL LIMITED for road renewal from North Service Road to south of Dundas Street.

items.title: Indigenous advisory services work status update
items.notes: Information report on Indigenous relationships and engagement work was received, with delegation from Eathan Sohma.

items.title: Community Survey follow-up presentation
items.notes: Final results of the Community Survey were presented to council for information.

items.title: Guidelines for Strong Mayor Powers and Council-Staff Relations Policy
items.notes: Adopted new Strong Mayor Powers guidelines and directed amendments to Council-Staff Relations Policy, with review of governance code alignment by Q2 2027.

items.title: Advisory Committees of Council Governance Framework
items.notes: Approved new governance framework for advisory committees and directed comprehensive review of committee portfolio for Q1 2027.

items.title: Downtown parking supply structure motion
items.notes: Referred motion to staff for June 2026 report on feasibility study scope and costing for downtown parking capacity by 2030, with input from Downtown Business Association.

items.title: Confidential Halton District School Board Lands
items.notes: Discussed in closed session regarding proposed land acquisition, with instructions provided to staff.

items.title: Confidential labour relations matter
items.notes: Staff withdrew this confidential human resources item before discussion.

items.title: Confidential legal update on 127 Plains Road litigation
items.notes: Discussed litigation matter in closed session with instructions provided to staff.

items.title: Resource funding agreements for fibre network buildout
items.notes: Authorized Director to negotiate cost-recovery agreements with telecommunications carriers for fibre optic network installation.

items.title: New Building Permit By-law
items.notes: Approved new building permit by-law to replace existing By-law 66-2019 under the Building Code Act.

items.title: Amendment to Burlington Housing Community Improvement Plan
items.notes: Approved amendments to Affordable Rental Housing Community Improvement Plan with implementation funding and direction for 2028 budget business case.

items.title: Zoning By-law Amendment for 1022, 1028, and 1030 Waterdown Road
items.notes: Approved zoning amendment after statutory public meeting with seven delegations speaking, including housing advocates and area residents.

items.title: Information items filing
items.notes: Received and filed seven information items including correspondence and staff presentations on various matters.
